mapper.sql: select cat_id, archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, qr_code, archived, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_profile

select cat_id, archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, (case when qr_code is not null and qr_code <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as has_qr_code, archived, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_profile
mapper.select: select t.tag_name from cat_tag t inner join cat_profile_tag pt on pt.tag_id = t.tag_id where pt.cat_id = #{catId} order by t.tag_id
select tag_id from cat_profile_tag where cat_id = #{catId} order by tag_id

select p.cat_id, p.archive_no, p.cat_name, p.sex, p.neutered, p.weight, p.status, p.remark, p.qr_code, b.base_name, w.ward_name, ph.photo_url, ph.photo_folder, (select concat(ifnull(v.vaccine_type, '疫苗'), ' · ', date_format(v.vaccine_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) from cat_vaccine v where v.cat_id = p.cat_id and v.del_flag = '0' order by v.vaccine_date desc, v.vaccine_id desc limit 1) as vaccine_text, coalesce( (select concat(r.hospital_name, ' · ', date_format(r.send_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) from cat_referral r where r.cat_id = p.cat_id and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.send_date desc, r.referral_id desc limit 1), nullif(p.hospital_name, '') ) as hospital_text, (select concat(date_format(d.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ', ifnull(d.diagnosis_result, '')) from cat_diagnosis d where d.cat_id = p.cat_id and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.visit_date desc, d.diagnosis_id desc limit 1) as diagnosis_text, (select group_concat(concat(date_format(m.use_date, '%m-%d'), ' ', ifnull(m.drug_name, ''), ifnull(concat(' ', m.dosage), '')) order by m.use_date desc, m.medication_id desc separator '\n') from cat_medication m where m.cat_id = p.cat_id and m.del_flag = '0') as medication_text from cat_profile p left join cat_base b on b.base_id = p.base_id left join cat_ward w on w.ward_id = p.ward_id
left join lateral ( select coalesce(nullif(p2.thumb_url, ''), p2.file_url) as photo_url, p2.folder as photo_folder from cat_photo p2 where p2.cat_id = p.cat_id and p2.file_type = '1' order by (p2.folder = '正面照') desc, p2.create_time desc, p2.photo_id desc limit 1 ) ph on true where p.cat_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update cat_profile set archived = #{archived}, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
mapper.insert: insert into cat_profile ( archive_no, cat_name, alias, breed, sex, age_estimate, weight, personality, source, capture_date, capture_point, neutered, dewormed, vaccinated, feature, status, base_id, ward_id, owner_base_id, hospital_name, qr_code, archived, create_by, create_time )values( #{archiveNo}, #{catName}, #{alias}, #{breed}, #{sex}, #{ageEstimate}, #{weight}, #{personality}, #{source}, #{captureDate}, #{capturePoint}, #{neutered}, #{dewormed}, #{vaccinated}, #{feature}, #{status}, #{baseId}, #{wardId}, #{ownerBaseId}, #{hospitalName}, #{qrCode}, #{archived}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: update cat_profile set del_flag = '2' where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set del_flag = '2' where cat_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update cat_profile set archived = '1', update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set ward_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set base_id = null, ward_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
update cat_profile set hospital_name = '', update_time = sysdate() where cat_id = #{catId}
